projects.title: Things Left Behind
connection_reasons: Three lyrics about the same aftermath: things a person left behind that cannot be moved yet (the grey sweater, the toothbrush) and the question of whether any of it was real.
All three share the same longing and the same refusal to say the ending out loud.

next_action.action: Write a chorus that says plainly what the sweater and the toothbrush are avoiding, and try ending it on 'and called it love'.

projects.title: Nobody Knows My Order
connection_reasons: A lyric about leaving with no plan and a sparse, open loop you named 'leave this place': the same wish to be somewhere new.

next_action.action: Speak or half-sing the coffee-order lines over 'leave this place', then write two lines about arriving somewhere.

projects.title: Absolutely Nothing
connection_reasons: A lyric about a night of doing nothing and a slow, unhurried loop you named 'Chilling': the same contentment in having no plans.

next_action.action: Hum a melody for 'this is the song for doing absolutely nothing' over 'Chilling', keeping it almost spoken.

projects.title: Too Heavy to Swim
connection_reasons: The lyric is about being too tired to keep swimming, and you named this quiet, minor-key loop 'lake bottoms'. Both are about sinking under a weight.

next_action.action: Sing the swimming lines quietly over 'lake bottoms' and mark the one place where the loop could brighten for a moment.
